selection.method: Live GitHub source search for Google ADK, Pydantic AI, and OpenAI Agents implementations. Candidates were source-screened for meaningful authority-bearing composition before any HorusTrace execution, checked against all committed HorusTrace cohort files (248 unique prior repositories), and frozen by exact repository SHA. Selection used source evidence only and did not use HorusTrace output.

cases.selection_signal: ADK Agent receives a dynamic list of MCP toolsets from imported get_adk_tools(), backed by an engine MCP registry/configuration rather than direct per-server wiring.
ADK Agent binds a CalculationMCPToolset over SSE with host/port destination derived from operator environment/configuration.
ADK voice agent combines filesystem stdio MCP scoped by CONTENT_FOLDER, hosted google_search, and an imported PDF reader tool.
Config-driven ADK agent composes RemoteA2aAgent delegation and Streamable HTTP MCP toolsets with bearer headers, allowed-tool filters, and dynamic list expansion.
Pydantic AI coding agent exposes model-selected file read/write paths and shell=True subprocess execution through decorated tools.
Decorated Pydantic tools delegate to imported Tavily/search and arbitrary-URL fetch helpers while also mutating an in-memory visited URL list.
Function-local Pydantic Agent binds an authenticated SSE MCP toolset at a supplied server URL and persists workbook changes through imported session/workbook helpers.
Pydantic AI trading agent binds a stdio MetaTrader MCP server whose advertised capabilities include account/position reads and order_send mutation authority.
OpenAI Agents customer-support hierarchy combines handoffs, hosted WebSearchTool, order reads, and a refund-request function whose source only documents 'Confirm with the user first'.
Triage agent uses an explicit InputGuardrail and hands off to imported specialists, including a README agent with recursive file listing and model-selected file reads.
Trading agents dynamically construct multiple stdio MCP servers and combine them with a researcher agent exposed via as_tool(), testing MCP composition plus agent-as-tool delegation.
OpenAI Agent exposes operator-configured authenticated marketplace HTTP tools that can route/invoke providers and automatically spend USDC within model-selected max_cost.
